Sample Processing Steps

  1. Sample concentrations were compared to blank concentrations. If sample concentration < blank concentration, then the sample concentration was set to zero.
  2. Dilution factor was applied to each sample. In most cases, DF=5
  3. Flags added to elments that had a poor standard curve.
  4. Elements that did not pass QAQC were removed from the dataset
  5. Removed samples that had low internal standards (<90%)
  6. Column added to data listing elements that did not pass QAQC
  7. Data exported to .csv

Preliminary Plot of Data

Fe2.dat<-read.csv("C:/Users/ashmo/OneDrive - Arizona State University/Data/TEMPEST/Porewater/04_SummarizedData/TMP_Fe2_all.csv")



icp.fe<-dat.clean%>%
  select(Sample.Id,Treatment,DF,ppm_Fe.axial)%>%
  mutate(Fe_total_uM = (ppm_Fe.axial*1000)/55.845)%>%
  rename(Sample_ID = Sample.Id)



all.fe<-left_join(icp.fe,Fe2.dat, by ="Sample_ID")%>%
  mutate(DateTime = paste(Collection_Date,Collection_Time))%>%
  mutate(DateTime = as.POSIXct(DateTime,c("%Y%m%d %H%M"),tz="EST"))


p<-ggplot(all.fe,aes(x=Fe_total_uM,y=Fe_2_uM))+
  geom_point(aes(color = Treatment))+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", linetype = "dashed",se=FALSE)+
  geom_abline(slope=1,intercept = 0)


print(p)
## `geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x'
## Warning: Removed 5 rows containing non-finite outside the scale range
## (`stat_smooth()`).
## Warning: Removed 5 rows containing missing values or values outside the scale range
## (`geom_point()`).

p<-all.fe%>%
   pivot_longer(cols = c(Fe_2_uM,Fe_total_uM),
    names_to = "Fe_Type",
    values_to = "Fe_uM",
    values_drop_na = TRUE)%>%
  ggplot(aes(x= Sample_ID, y = Fe_uM))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",aes(fill = Fe_Type),position = position_dodge(1))+
  facet_wrap(~Treatment,scales="free",ncol=1)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust =1))


print(p)
